returns.condition: Items must be unused, undamaged, complete and in original condition; original packaging wherever possible.
returns.refund: Refunded to the original payment method once the item is received and checked.
returns.notReturnable: Used, washed, altered or damaged items, and furniture that has been assembled and taken apart, unless faulty.
returns.damagedOrFaulty: Tell us as soon as possible, ideally with a photo; we arrange a repair, replacement or refund.
returns.howToStart: Contact us or ask Mira with the order and item; we confirm the return and agree how it comes back.
returns.exchanges: Return the original item and place a new order for the one you want.

delivery.summary: Free standard delivery on orders over $500; otherwise a flat $49 per order.
delivery.perOrder: The charge is per order, not per item.
delivery.timing: No specific delivery dates are promised; we get in touch once the order is on its way and agree a day for large furniture.
delivery.stock: Stock levels are not shown; if a piece is unavailable after ordering we contact you first.

assembly.available: For furniture: sofas, beds, desks, tables, chairs, shelving and storage.
assembly.summary: Assembly service for furniture at a flat $79 per item, built in the room you choose, packaging taken away.
assembly.excludes: Wall mounting, electrical installation, moving or disposing of existing furniture, and decor or textiles.
assembly.diy: Furniture that needs assembly comes with instructions.

care.general: Follow the product's own care label first; these are general guides.
care.wood: Dust with a soft cloth along the grain, wipe spills at once, use coasters and trivets, keep away from heat and strong sun.
care.linen: Wash cool to warm on gentle, no bleach, line or low dry; it softens with each wash and creases naturally.
care.boucle: Vacuum gently with a soft brush, blot spills without rubbing, keep away from claws and velcro; professional clean for stains.
care.wool: Vacuum without a beater bar, rotate rugs, blot spills with cold water; some early shedding is normal.
care.cotton: Machine wash per label, darks separately at first, low tumble or line dry.
care.leather: Dust, blot spills, condition every few months, keep from heat and sun, no household cleaners.
care.ceramic: Check dishwasher, microwave and oven suitability first; hand wash handmade pieces; avoid sudden temperature changes.
care.brass: Dust with a dry cloth; patina is natural; polish only unlacquered brass with a brass polish.
care.castIron: Hand wash, dry at once, oil lightly to keep seasoned; scrub and reseason if rust appears.
